features: Add a floating return button directly above the existing MEMO tab after a SIGNAL MATRIX symbol is used to jump to a chart.
The return button restores the expanded SIGNAL MATRIX and returns to the same page/table scroll position that was active before the chart jump.
The previous search text and S-state filter context are restored when returning to the table.
No matrix calculations, sorting, chart data, memo/R2 behavior, Worker, engine, research, filters, or sector-flow calculations are changed.
